lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.45 - A Listen and number.

details: Listen and number checks students' recall of the target vocabulary from Units 3 and 4 (places in town and what we did), and gives them the opportunity to practise listening for detail.
Look for careful listening, accurate identification of the target vocabulary, and correct numbering of the boxes.
“Yesterday I did lots of things! What did I do? I went into town with my friends. Can you listen and remind me where we went and what we did?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

details: Listen and choose reviews the target language and key structures from Units 3 and 4 and offers a further opportunity to practise listening for detail.
Look for careful listening, accurate identification of the pictures based on the descriptions, and correct circling of the letters.

“Great, thank you for helping me with that. What do you like to do in town? Use the pictures to get ideas! Some of my other friends also went into town yesterday. Let’s listen and find out where they went and what they did.”

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.99 - A Read and match.

details: Read and match checks students' understanding of the key language at a sentence level, strengthens recognition of target words and helps develop reading comprehension skills.
Look for students correctly identifying the images and  drawing lines to the correct sentences.
“Uh oh, the sentences and the pictures are in the wrong order! Can you help me match the sentences to the correct pictures? You can? Great!”

Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.99 - B Look and write.

details: Look and write strengthens recognition of the target language and key structures and gives students an opportunity to practise them, by writing the appropriate question or answer on the lines, reinforcing language chunk recall.
Look for correct word choice, word order and spelling, neat handwriting on the lines, and appropriate spacing between the words.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.46 - C. Listen and read.

details: Listen and read allows students to review the key structures and target language from Units 3 and 4, and practise their literacy skills.
Look for careful listening, students following the text while they listen, and clear pronunciation, steady pacing, and correct identification of each word while they read.

“Look, a cake! Yum. What does it say? Happy birthday! I love birthdays! On my birthday I went to the cinema. Then I bought some new clothes! Do you want to know what Lisa did on her birthday? Let’s read and find out.”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.46 - D. Choose or write the correct answers. 10m]

details: Choose or write the correct answers checks students’ understanding of the text and gives them an opportunity to practise reading for understanding.
Look for correct circling/writing of the answers and the ability to identify where in the text they found the answers.
“Great reading, but I forgot what Lisa did on her birthday! Can you help me remember? Did she make a cake? Or go shopping in the morning? Let’s see who can answer!”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Chant): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video Chant): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4R
